title: PACE：一种用于生成合理且可操作的反事实解释的神经符号框架
summary: PACE是一个模块化的神经符号框架，通过将神经网络预测模型与符号推理层分离，在生成反事实解释时显式编码领域知识和干预约束，从而产生符合领域知识、可解释且可操作的解释。在Adult Income数据集上的案例研究表明，符号约束能生成更满足领域可行性要求的解释。
summary_en: PACE is a modular neuro-symbolic framework that separates neural prediction from symbolic reasoning to enforce domain-specific constraints during counterfactual generation, producing explanations that are consistent with domain knowledge, interpretable, and actionable. A case study on the Adult Income dataset shows symbolic constraints yield explanations that better satisfy domain-specific feasibility requirements.
